q1.question: Is DocAgora free for patients?
q1.answer: Yes, creating an account, searching for professionals and booking appointments is completely free. You only pay your healthcare provider directly, as you would normally.

q2.question: Are the professionals verified?
q2.answer: Every healthcare professional on DocAgora is reviewed and approved by our team before going live. We verify their credentials, registration number and professional standing.

q3.question: What languages is DocAgora available in?
q3.answer: The platform is available in Portuguese, French and English. You can also filter professionals by the languages they speak during consultations.

q4.question: How do I book an appointment?
q4.answer: Search for a professional by specialty, city or language. Compare profiles, reviews and availability. Choose a time slot and confirm your booking in one click. You'll receive an email confirmation instantly.

q5.question: Can I cancel or reschedule my appointment?
q5.answer: Yes, you can cancel or reschedule from your patient account at any time. We recommend doing so at least 24 hours before your appointment out of respect for the professional's time.

q6.question: Is my personal data safe?
q6.answer: DocAgora is fully GDPR-compliant. Your personal data is hosted in Europe and is never shared with third parties without your explicit consent. We take your privacy seriously.

q7.question: Which cities are covered?
q7.answer: DocAgora is available across major Portuguese cities including Lisbon, Porto, Coimbra, Braga, Faro and Cascais. We are continuously expanding our network of professionals.

q8.question: Do I need to create an account?
q8.answer: You can browse professionals and their availability without an account. However, you'll need to create a free account to book appointments and receive reminders.

q9.question: How do I contact support?
q9.answer: You can reach our team at hello@docagora.com. We aim to respond within 24 hours. The platform is available 24/7 for searching and booking.

q10.question: Can I filter professionals by insurance?
q10.answer: Yes, you can filter professionals by the health insurance plans they accept. This helps you find in-network providers and avoid unexpected costs.
